calculation.description: Ranks assets favoring recent five-session underperformers after scaling the shock by their trailing 20-session daily volatility; the one-session lag prevents look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 10-session IC was negative in 2020-2023 (-0.009427) but positive in 2024-2026 (0.002557), 2027-2029 (0.027983), 2030-2032 (0.020728), and 2033-2035 (0.030028). Interpret the small 15-asset cross-section conservatively; longer-horizon decay is mixed, with strong 60-session diagnostic.

provenance.method: daily cross-sectional Pearson IC of lagged factor versus forward close-to-close returns
